class.name: ScriptDiagnosticCaptureScope
class.brief_description: Scoped helper that starts and stops a [ScriptDiagnosticCapture] exactly once.
class.description: [ScriptDiagnosticCaptureScope] wraps a [ScriptDiagnosticCapture] with a stop-exactly-once contract and a destructor safety net. Dropping the scope without calling [method stop] still restores diagnostic output state, which keeps per-test capture reliable across async code, teardowns, runtime failures, and future timeout/abort paths. Nested scopes preserve broadcast semantics: every active capture receives each diagnostic event. Quiet restoration remains nest-safe through the global quiet refcount already used by [ScriptDiagnosticCapture]. [b]Composition with [ScriptTestExecution][/b] Recommended runner pattern: capture outside, guard inside — start a quiet scope, [code]await[/code] [method ScriptTestExecution.guard_callv], then [method stop] — so guard-initiated unwinds never leak an active capture. [codeblock] var diagnostics := ScriptDiagnosticCaptureScope.start(true) var execution_result: ScriptTestExecutionResult = await execution.guard_callv(suite, test_case.method_name, test_case.arguments) diagnostics.stop() context.set_diagnostics(diagnostics.capture) [/codeblock] [b]Async helpers[/b] [method capture_async] records script runtime errors as ordinary diagnostic events but does not alter error control flow. Whether a captured diagnostic fails a test remains runner policy.

method.name: capture
method.description: Starts a capture, invokes [param callable] synchronously, stops the capture, and returns a [ScriptDiagnosticCaptureResult].

method.name: capture_async
method.description: Like [method capture], but when [param callable] suspends and returns a [ScriptFunctionState] handle, returns a pending handle whose [signal ScriptFunctionState.completed] emits a [ScriptDiagnosticCaptureResult] once the coroutine finishes. Synchronous callables return the result object directly, so [code]await ScriptDiagnosticCaptureScope.capture_async(...)[/code] works for both sync and async callables.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the scope's capture is active and [method stop] has not been called.

method.name: start
method.description: Creates a scope and starts its internal capture.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the capture. Safe to call more than once; only the first call has an effect.

members.member: The underlying capture, exposing the full query surface after [method stop].
